id.description: Unique identifier of the Action Plan Template.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template was created. ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Description of the template in rich text (HTML) form.

description_plain_text.description: Description of the template in plain text form.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the template. Templates must be 'published' before plans can be created from them.

private.description: Whether the template is restricted to participants only.

title.description: Title of the Action Plan Template.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Action Plan type.

active.description: Whether this type is enabled for use. When false, it is hidden from selection when creating new plans or templates.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the type was created. ISO 8601 format.

name.description: Localized display name of the Action Plan type.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the type was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

source_key.description: System key identifying a built-in type. Null for user-created custom types.

provider_type.description: Scope of the template. 'company' templates are company-wide; 'project' templates are project-specific.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the template was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
